ui_bugs.issue: When 'Deschide viewer imersiv' (open-3d-viewer) is clicked for a project whose model_url returns a placeholder (non-binary) GLB, GLTFLoader throws 'Unexpected token g, glb is not valid JSON' and the drei Suspense error bubbles to a top-level runtime error overlay (Uncaught runtime errors) that visually replaces the unified modal. Root cause is INVALID SEED DATA: /api/digital-twin/files/66a3f190.../bff7c8d17d94.glb returns 3 bytes literal 'glb'; the second project returns 13 bytes 'glTF-anc...' — neither is a valid glTF Binary. This is not a P1 code regression, but Founder acceptance says 'existing viewers work' — the viewer needs an ErrorBoundary that keeps the unified modal alive and shows a graceful 'Model 3D indisponibil (fișier corupt/placeholder)' state instead of crashing.

action_items: Seed: replace placeholder .glb bytes for property 6a11d70e600be19667009c93 projects (66a3f19...bff7c8d17d94.glb and 4721aede...a93874c3f374.glb) with a minimal valid GLB (glTF magic + JSON chunk + BIN chunk) so DigitalTwinViewer regression can complete end-to-end. Currently servers return 3-byte 'glb' and 13-byte 'glTF-anc...' respectively.
